imagelab.description: Man in his early-to-mid 40s (apparent 40-46). Deliberately ambiguous ethnic origin: slight Slavic cheekbones, olive-warm skin, angular jaw, dark grey-green eyes, direct calm gaze without warmth. Dark brown-black hair, natural texture, not styled. Slim-athletic build. Natural skin texture, visible pores, micro-asymmetry, not retouched. Wardrobe strictly monochromatic black or deep charcoal: tailored dark shirt open 1-2 buttons (never a turtleneck), structured dark blazer, straight-cut dark trousers, black leather or technical sneakers. Permanent accessories: Movado Museum watch with black dial, chrome index and integrated steel bracelet; two symmetric white gold micro ear pins with 0.03ct diamonds; thin white gold chain 1.2mm with a geometric white gold pendant set with a dark stone (black spinel, dark ruby or deep amethyst). No rings, no other jewelry, no logos.
